title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18784v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against

translated_title: 轻装上阵，CarryOn：为长时程智能体构建面向对象的上下文
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体在持久化任务状态中积累进展，却需要反复处理描述这些进展如何实现的交互历史。这引出一个自然的问题：长时程上下文能否围绕可复用的进展而非产生它的历史来组织？在本文中，我们提出 CarryOn，一个面向对象的上下文运行时，它围绕可复用的任务对象来组织续接过程。CarryOn 不将压缩历史或重建的进展叙述作为续接的主要依据，而是从续接载体、互补执行上下文以及近期交互的实时尾部构建上下文视图。一个核心挑战是在周边历史被淘汰后保持这一可复用基础的有效性：CarryOn 如何在每次折叠时无需重建完整表示就能更新该基础？CarryOn 在多次折叠之间维护载体记录，并对受影响的记录进行修订……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 CarryOn，一个面向对象的上下文运行时，通过围绕可复用的任务对象（而非交互历史）来组织长时程智能体的上下文，使其能够在折叠过程中高效更新续接载体记录而无需重建完整表示。
en_tdlr: CarryOn is an object-oriented context runtime that organizes long-horizon agent context around reusable task objects rather than interaction histories, efficiently updating carrier records across folds without reconstructing full representations.
